name: Coaster lock
summary: A roller coaster train with everyone's seat: each 'in' drops a lap bar and clicks the train up the lift hill; at the target it crests, drops and becomes the event with the riders as hosts.
useWhen: 'saturday lake day real or fake', a plan that happens only if enough people commit
a day trip or outing waiting on a few more yeses, some with conditions ('if it's above 70')
dontUseWhen: choosing where or what (use a poll or claw-pick)
finding a date that works (use clear-skies or meeting-time)
an event that already exists (use its RSVP)

params.title: string
params.event: {place, when, dow (3 letters), date (day of month)}
params.forecast: number, degrees F the thermometer shows
params.riders: up to 8 x {name, in, said, above (degrees, 0 for no condition)}
